comment: The DSP is the Dead Man's Catch firmware for Peaks, vendored at alt_firmware/deadman; src/mortuus.cpp is the Rack wrapper, built on the same frame as Apices. The outputs are left without a family because what they carry is set by the mode rather than by the patch. The maker names neither input nor output in the source, so Rack's own tooltips for the four jacks are blank. The manual's mode table gives the drum generator's display text as DRUM GENERAT; modeDisplayLabels in src/mortuus.hpp spells it BASS/SNARE, which is what the panel actually shows. The manual also lists the bouncing ball envelope as a Dead Man's Catch addition marked with a hash, though Apices carries it too. The hi-hat, which the hardware hid at the clockwise end of the snare knobs, is a mode of its own here. The trigger threshold is 0.7V.
